clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz prepares Jetsteam for a long deployment with the Ironforge Siege Brigade. The crew needs boar meat and bear pelts for the journey.

Pilot Bellowfiz prepares Jetsteam at Steelgrill's Depot, just outside Kharanos. The siege tank is bound for a long operation with the Siege Brigade. Master engineer Beldin Steelgrill is tuning its mechanisms, while the crew needs a month's provisions for Dun Morogh's sub-zero cold.

Beldin Steelgrill is occupied beneath Jetsteam's hood, leaving Bellowfiz unable to leave the vehicle to gather food and insulation. Snowy plains south of the Grizzled Den hold boars and bears. Their meat can feed the crew, and their pelts can line the tank's bedding.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade. It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies. So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?
I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food. You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... You can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Preparations are going well. How goes your hunting?

clips.title: Completion
paras: By Magni's beard, you sure did a lot of hunting!! Thank you, friend.
